sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com) pages and spell lists, read through WebSearch summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine (the search summaries name the pages and quote their descriptions).
sources.ja_search: Japanese pages found by WebSearch (ja.wikipedia.org Black Clover article, manga-tantei.com character articles, pixiv encyclopedia, ja.namu.wiki spell list, bclover.jp character files): Japanese spell names and one-line effects, read through search summaries only.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs (the exact chapter or episode of most spells was not confirmed): see docs/magic/character_spells_gold.md.

spells.name: Mercury Magic: Silver Blade
spells.note: Listed on the wiki; mode 0 of the book.

spells.name: Mercury Magic: Silver Spear
spells.note: A spear of mercury launched at a target; several can be made and fired together; extreme heat melts it.

spells.name: Mercury Magic: Silver Rain
spells.note: Countless droplets of mercury fall from the sky; their density lets them punch through obstacles; good against groups.

spells.name: Mercury Magic: Silver Eagle
spells.note: Listed as a supplementary spell on the wiki; the giant eagle of liquid silver.

spells.name: Mercury Magic: Silver Guardian
spells.note: With an open grimoire, mercury becomes a defensive coating over the whole body; poisonous to him, so it harms him while it runs. The page keeps its old id mercury_shield.

spells.name: Mercury Magic: Silver Shining Regal Spear
spells.note: A long-range shot of mercury from the palm; the strongest after the Star of Execution.

spells.name: Mercury Creation Magic: Silver Star of Execution
spells.note: Mercury strands and drops are spread over an area and gathered into a giant cage whose bars switch between spears and shields. His signature.

planned.name: Valkyrie Armor / Silver Sunset
planned.note: Valkyrie Armor is another builder's; Silver Sunset was not found in any summary.

notes: All eight pages of the Mercury book are Nozel's in the sources, so his grimoire shows the whole book; what the set adds is the ORDER he gets them in and the signature marking. The order is the mod's design (no source gave the episodes); the Mana Zone alternatives follow the Spade Kingdom arc where he uses it. No new page: the book already had all of his spells, and the Valkyrie Armour belongs to another builder.
